154        public CampaignFleetAPI createFleet(StarSystemAPI system, Random random) {
155        
156                //float f = intel.getMarketPresenceFactor(system);
157                
158                int maxSize = 0;
159                for (MarketAPI curr : Misc.getMarketsInLocation(system, Factions.PLAYER)) {
160                        maxSize = Math.max(curr.getSize(), maxSize);
161                }
162                
163                //int difficulty = 0 + (int) Math.max(1f, Math.round(f * 6f));
164                int difficulty = maxSize + 1;
165                difficulty += random.nextInt(4);
166                if (difficulty > 10) difficulty = 10;
167                
168                FleetCreatorMission m = new FleetCreatorMission(random);
169                m.beginFleet();
170                
171                Vector2f loc = system.getLocation();
172                String factionId = Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH;
173                
174                m.createStandardFleet(difficulty, factionId, loc);
175                m.triggerSetFleetQuality(FleetQuality.HIGHER);
176                m.triggerSetFleetType(FleetTypes.SACRED_PROTECTORS);
177                m.triggerSetPatrol();
178                m.triggerSetFleetHasslePlayer(HASSLE_REASON);
179                m.triggerSetFleetFlag("$sacredProtectors");
180                
181                m.triggerFleetAllowLongPursuit();
182                m.triggerMakeLowRepImpact();
183                
184                //m.triggerMakeHostile();
185                //m.triggerMakeHostileWhileTransponderOff();
186                
187                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = m.createFleet();
188                
189                if (fleet != null) {
190                        fleet.setName("Knights of Ludd " + fleet.getName());
191                        fleet.setNoFactionInName(true);
192                        NPCHassler hassle = new NPCHassler(fleet, system);
193                        hassle.getParams().crDamageMult = 0f; 
194                        fleet.addScript(hassle);
195                }
196
197                return fleet;
198        }

212        public void addStageDescriptionForEvent(HostileActivityEventIntel intel, EventStageData stage, TooltipMakerAPI info) {
213                float small = 0f;
214                float opad = 10f;
215                
216                small = 8f;
217
218                LabelAPI label = info.addPara("You've received intel that the Knights of Ludd, under the aegis of the Luddic Church, "
219                                + "are planning an operation to take over one of your colonies that has a Luddic Majority "
220                                + "population.",
221                                small, Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), "take over one of your colonies");
222                label.setHighlight("take over one of your colonies", "Luddic Majority");
223                label.setHighlightColors(Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(),
224                                Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH).getBaseUIColor());
225                
226                label = info.addPara("If the expedition is defeated, the Luddic faithful leaving the Church worlds "
227                                + "will feel more secure, resulting in increased immigration, stability, and productivity, "
228                                + "and the Luddic Church will likely abandon further efforts of this sort.", 
229                                opad);
230                label.setHighlight("increased immigration, stability, and productivity", "Luddic Church");
231                label.setHighlightColors(Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor(),
232                                Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH).getBaseUIColor());
233                
234                Color c = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH).getBaseUIColor();
235                stage.beginResetReqList(info, true, "crisis", opad);
236                info.addPara("You make an agreement with the Church", 0f);
237                info.addPara("%s is tactically bombarded", 0f, c, "Hesperus");
238                stage.endResetReqList(info, false, "crisis", -1, -1);
239                
240                addBorder(info, Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH).getBaseUIColor());
241        }

256        public float getEventFrequency(HostileActivityEventIntel intel, EventStageData stage) {
257                if (stage.id == Stage.HA_EVENT) {
258                        if (isDefeatedExpedition() || getHesperus(true) == null) {
259                                return 0f;
260                        }
261                        
262                        if (KnightsOfLuddTakeoverExpedition.get() != null) {
263                                return 0f;
264                        }
265                        
266                        MarketAPI target = findExpeditionTarget(intel, stage);
267                        MarketAPI source = getExpeditionSource(intel, stage, target);
268                        if (target != null && source != null) {
269                                return 20f;
270                        }
271                }
272                return 0;
273        }

282        public boolean fireEvent(HostileActivityEventIntel intel, EventStageData stage) {
283                MarketAPI target = findExpeditionTarget(intel, stage);
284                MarketAPI source = getExpeditionSource(intel, stage, target);
285                if (source == null || target == null) {
286                        return false;
287                }
288        
289                stage.rollData = null;
290                return startExpedition(source, target, stage, getRandomizedStageRandom(3));
291        }

293        
294        public MarketAPI findExpeditionTarget(HostileActivityEventIntel intel, EventStageData stage) {
295                WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI>(getRandomizedStageRandom());
296                for (MarketAPI market : Misc.getPlayerMarkets(false)) {
297                        if (market.getStarSystem() == null) continue;
298                        if (market.hasCondition(Conditions.LUDDIC_MAJORITY)) {
299                                float size = market.getSize();
300                                float w = Math.max(size - 3f, 1f);
301                                w = w * w * w;
302                                picker.add(market, w);
303                        }
304                }
305                return picker.pick();
306        }

312        public static MarketAPI getHesperus(boolean requireMilitaryBase) {
313                MarketAPI hesperus = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("hesperus");
314                if (hesperus == null || hesperus.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED) ||
315                                !hesperus.getFactionId().equals(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH)) {
316                        return null;
317                }
318                if (requireMilitaryBase) {
319                        Industry b = hesperus.getIndustry(Industries.MILITARYBASE);
320                        if (b == null) b = hesperus.getIndustry(Industries.HIGHCOMMAND);
321                        if (b == null || b.isDisrupted() || !b.isFunctional()) {
322                                return null;
323                        }
324                }
325                return hesperus;
326        }

329        public boolean startExpedition(MarketAPI source, MarketAPI target, EventStageData stage, Random random) {
330
331                GenericRaidParams params = new GenericRaidParams(new Random(random.nextLong()), true);
332                params.factionId = source.getFactionId();
333                params.source = source;
334                
335                params.prepDays = 7f + random.nextFloat() * 14f;
336                params.payloadDays = 180f;
337                
338                params.makeFleetsHostile = false;
339                
340                FGBlockadeParams bParams = new FGBlockadeParams();
341                bParams.where = target.getStarSystem();
342                bParams.targetFaction = Factions.PLAYER;
343                bParams.specificMarket = target;
344                
345                params.noun = "takeover";
346                params.forcesNoun = "Luddic forces";
347                
348                params.style = FleetStyle.STANDARD;
349                
350                
351                params.fleetSizes.add(10); // first size 10 pick becomes the Armada
352                
353                // and a few smaller picket forces
354                params.fleetSizes.add(4);
355                params.fleetSizes.add(4);
356                params.fleetSizes.add(3);
357                params.fleetSizes.add(3);
358
359                
360                KnightsOfLuddTakeoverExpedition blockade = new KnightsOfLuddTakeoverExpedition(params, bParams);
361                blockade.setListener(this);
362                Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(blockade);
363                
364                return true;
365        }

392        public void reportTacticalBombardmentFinished(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, MarketAPI market, TempData actionData) {
393                if (isDefeatedExpedition() || isMadeDeal()) return;
394                
395                MarketAPI hesperus = getHesperus(false);
396                if (market != null && market == hesperus) {
397                        EventStageData stage = intel.getDataFor(Stage.HA_EVENT);
398                        if (stage != null) {
399                                boolean thisEvent = stage.rollData instanceof HAERandomEventData && 
400                                                ((HAERandomEventData)stage.rollData).factor == this;
401                                // no points if takeover expedition is the event since it'll lead to a reset anyway
402                                if (!thisEvent) {
403                                        int points = Global.getSettings().getInt("HA_tacBombardHesperus");
404                                        if (points > 0) {
405                                                intel.addFactor(new HAHersperusTacBombardmentFactor(-points));
406                                        }
407                                }
408                        }
409
410                }
411        }

435        public void reportColonySizeChanged(MarketAPI market, int prevSize) {
436                if (!market.isPlayerOwned()) return;
437                
438                boolean matches = LuddicMajority.matchesBonusConditions(market);
439                
440                if (market.hasCondition(Conditions.LUDDIC_MAJORITY) && !matches) {
441                        market.removeCondition(Conditions.LUDDIC_MAJORITY);
442                } else if (!market.hasCondition(Conditions.LUDDIC_MAJORITY) && matches) {
443                        market.addCondition(Conditions.LUDDIC_MAJORITY);
444                }
445                
446        }
